name: Tandoori chicken
assumptions: Yield estimated from 16 chicken thighs (2 per serving is standard for this style of recipe)
Total time includes 10 min lemon-paprika step + minimum 1 hr marinating + 16 min grilling; does not include optional longer marinating up to 24 hrs
Greek yogurt classified as containing milk
No wheat, barley, rye or oats listed so gluten-free
No explicit tree-nut or sesame ingredients but ambiguous if any compound spice blend contains them
All other allergens confidently absent based on listed ingredients
instructions:
Mix the lemon juice with the paprika and red onions in a large shallow dish. Slash each chicken thigh three times, then turn them in the juice and set aside for 10 mins.
Mix all of the marinade ingredients together and pour over the chicken. Give everything a good mix, then cover and chill for at least 1 hr. This can be done up to a day in advance.
Heat the grill. Lift the chicken pieces onto a rack over a baking tray. Brush over a little oil and grill for 8 mins on each side or until lightly charred and completely cooked through.
